# ubiops_pipeline (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing UbiOps pipeline.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ubiops_pipeline" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-pipeline"
}

output "pipeline_id" {
  value = data.ubiops_pipeline.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pipeline
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date when the pipeline was created
- `default_version` (String) Default version of the pipeline
- `description` (String) Description of the pipeline
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the pipeline (UUID)
- `input_type` (String) The type of the input of the pipeline
- `output_type` (String) The type of the output of the pipeline
